Scripts.OnLoad:
-- All events we need self.allEvents = { "PLAYER_LOGIN", "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD", "PLAYER_REGEN_ENABLED", "ZONE_CHANGED_NEW_AREA", "ARENA_OPPONENT_UPDATE", "ARENA_PREP_OPPONENT_SPECIALIZATIONS", "PLAYER_TARGET_CHANGED", "UNIT_HEALTH", "UNIT_MAXHEALTH", "UNIT_POWER_UPDATE", "UNIT_MAXPOWER", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_SUCCEEDED", "UNIT_AURA", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_START", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_STOP", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_FAILED", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_INTERRUPTED", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_START", "UNIT_SPELLCAST_CHANNEL_STOP", "COMBAT_LOG_EVENT_UNFILTERED", } self.eventsRegistered = false
-- Only register events if NOT in combat (Midnight 12.0 protection) if not InCombatLockdown() then for _, event in ipairs(self.allEvents) do self:RegisterEvent(event) end self.eventsRegistered = true else -- In combat - enable OnUpdate to wait for combat end self:SetScript("OnUpdate", self.WaitForCombatEnd) end
Scripts.OnEvent: -- Route events to addon callbacks local callbacks = GladiusMidnightEventCallbacks if callbacks and callbacks[event] then callbacks[event](event, ...) end

Ui.Script: -- OnUpdate function to wait for combat to end function GladiusMidnightEventFrame:WaitForCombatEnd(elapsed) if not InCombatLockdown() then -- Combat ended, register all events for _, event in ipairs(self.allEvents) do self:RegisterEvent(event) end self.eventsRegistered = true -- Disable OnUpdate self:SetScript("OnUpdate", nil) end end
